ownership: Action-time generation plus exact private worker-state identity; receipts bind admission-time generation, not worker-start generation.
Admission/receipt registration and nonblocking enqueue/rollback share b.mu; each task individually completes its receipt in a defer.
One captured bounded receipt set; later accepted tasks do not extend the wait; out-of-order completions cannot discharge earlier tasks.
Stop/retirement wakes waiters before physical native/HAR worker joins; original cleanup and panic propagation remain.
Final exact owner and still-live deadline are rechecked with detached network-buffer clone under the same b.mu lock.
Stale receipts may finish their own pending obligation but cannot mark replacement generation incomplete; no unbounded generation/history map.

closed_findings: Replaced obsolete worker-start generation pin with receipt/action generation authority.
Added final context/deadline recheck under snapshot lock.
Kept owned snapshot application separate from legacy generic-buffer wrapper, preventing accidental second network recapture.
Root V2 review: status helper now samples ctx.Err once, avoiding cancellation being mislabeled metadata_timeout across two reads; deterministic wait-level real-WithCancel regression added.
limitations: No actual Go/race/native/API execution has occurred on this candidate.

Normal context_each_iteration replacement completes Teardown before Init, preserving existing physical joins. Private metadata-state retirement only wakes metadata waiters and does not stop the old physical workers; no generic restart/double-start guarantee. Generation-only changes already visible before settle are rejected immediately; changes during waiting without lifecycle retirement are rejected at final check within the five-second wait bound.
Complete accepted metadata is not a browser traffic census and does not wait for future network requests.

startup_and_restart_scope.actual_order: openBrowserContext installs document evidence (runtime_context.go:88), handlers, NewPage, then starts workers (runtime_context.go:109). The candidate does not change that order.
startup_and_restart_scope.generation_authority: The helper deliberately binds generation at action/admission time plus exact worker-state identity; no current initialization-before-evidence claim.
startup_and_restart_scope.sole_production_caller: startNetworkWorkers is called only by openBrowserContext, reached from Browser.Init.
startup_and_restart_scope.normal_iteration_replacement: VUser.resetProtocolForIteration (vuser.go:1730–1746) requires successful protocol Teardown before Init. Non-HAR close waits networkWorkerWG; successful owned HAR retirement waits runtimeDone, whose runtime join includes networkWorkerWG.Wait.
startup_and_restart_scope.limit: retireNetworkWorkersLocked closes only private metadata-waiter stop and does not stop the old physical networkWorkerStop. This candidate preserves the original Init/Teardown lifecycle; it does not add a generic restart or safe double-start contract.
